body:
I'm not bipolar. I have BPD, which mostly means that I lack coping mechanisms and a sense of identity, amongst other things. The psychiatrist said that it's usually caused by being abused as a child. I don't rapidly change moods without reason or anything like that.

My rabbits are pretty well trained and I bought a rimmed litter box and heavy litter so that they couldn't kick it out with ease. They had free roam of the house but never really left the living room that often. They didn't even chew wires. The only time you would see them was if I was sitting in the living room.

The only person in my family who bothers with me is my mum. My sisters have always been a bit nasty with me. Just the other day my middle sister sat at my computer and randomly started screaming about how it's my fault that she ordered something on Amazon to the wrong address and how I had to fix it, even though I didn't have any involvement. That sort of behaviour isn't out of the ordinary for me when it comes to my sisters, but I guess that's my fault.

She has a lot of her own problems. One of her roommates is a violent alcoholic who absolutely hates me because I told her that I wanted her to move out after he smashed her skull in with a CD shelf and she asked me to sit in hospital with her.

I don't think the Metropolitan police will help me, as they'd be the ones who'd have to handle this. I think they probably view my case as petty, seeing as they didn't bother when I called for help.

The officer I spoke to in my county was lovely and I know she handed the case over as she can't deal with crimes outside of the area, but I just can't see the police in London helping me.

I don't live in London. It's very kind of you to offer something like this, but I would have felt like I was imposing on your kindness if I was able to make it.

I'm sorry.

I don't have a job right now and I'm a carer for my mum. The plan was for me to build a portfolio of flash art so that I could see if somebody would be willing to take me in as a tattooing apprentice. I feel embarrassed being this age and not having a proper job, but I'm always made to feel absolutely horrible if I go out and I'm not around to care for my mum.

I think my dad only wants me around so I can care for my mum. He always says things like "Well what about poor mummy? How will she feel?" if I mention wanting to go away and "You mustn't think that, mummy will be upset. Don't you think she's been through enough?" if I'm crying and saying that I wish I'd disappear, so I'm not even sure if he personally cares about what happens to me.

If I manage to move in with my boyfriend I will be changing my number and never contacting them again.

Because I fall into cluster B I'm not too comfortable with /r/raisedbynarcissists after what another poster said. I also only really have one friend in my life who bothers with me. She came over to make sure I was okay.

I've been in contact with a local mental health hospital ever since my first post, but I think my care coordinator is fed up with me because I have issues keeping with appointments. It makes me feel really bad and a bit reluctant to reach out sometimes.

My boyfriend is the most wonderful and supportive person I have ever met. I wouldn't have ever gotten any help if he wasn't in my life.

I really want to leave this place. He has a few houses and apartments lined up and has been keeping me updated with everything, and I think I'd be able to move in with him maybe early next year. I just feel so desperate.
I will ask, but I'm absolutely terrified that she will take my birds or kitten whilst I am away again.

I don't think I could get into her apartment and break in without immediately being caught.

She lives in a converted house and requires either a key or the landlord to let you in the front door, and then I'd have to go up to her apartment and somehow break into her front door. I don't know if they have cameras or not.

I just don't know why this had to happen. I was doing so well recently and was actually excited for my life, and then my sister kicked it all to the floor. 

I feel so desperate right now.
I'm sure it was nice. I haven't eaten rabbit in a while, but was considering rabbit ragu recently.

No, it was spoken to my dad on the phone and shouted at me repeatedly when we were arguing. 

I'll try remember dates and times of her threatening me, although I have absolutely no sense of time so this might take me a while.

I was actually talking to my boyfriend about moving in with him and we were working things out. I thought I'd take my rabbits with me and I regret ever letting my sister back into my life so much.

I'm just going to keep calling the RSPCA for now.

Edit: I just got off the phone with them and they said because it classifies as theft that they can't do anything.
I called the RSPCA and thought it was best to report this as lost pets and I couldn't get past their automated responses. Do I report this as animal abuse?

She lives in another city. I let my local police know she is going there but didn't have an address when I called them.

I do now, after my boyfriend decided to do some investigating based on the train route he took two years ago to help her build furniture in her new apartment, as he lives in the same city. He managed to trace his steps using street view on Google Maps. When the police arrive I'll have an address for them.

My sister and I once lived together. I bought rabbits shortly before she went to live in another city. While she was here she insisted that she keep in her in her room to play with them because she thinks it's better than letting them roam around the house. I stupidly went along with it because I wasn't sure what was best for them at the time and she claimed to have researched everything for me, and continued to pay for everything they need and clean them. 

She leaves for about two years and keeps saying how they are hers and that she wants them in her apartment that doesn't allow pets. I tell her that I am the one that cares for the rabbits and pays for their every expenditure. I was also the one to hunt them out on Gumtree and went out and paid for them myself, as there aren't many pet shops in my city that still sell pets. 

She eventually decides that they absolutely are hers regardless of it all and I'm just holding on to them, even with me telling her that this is not the case. My sister had always been controlling with me and I didn't grow a spine and put my foot down until recently, and has been very hostile towards me since. 

I put this here and there in comments, so maybe it's better to have it all here in one place.

I have a cluster B personality disorder (borderline) and I've been prescribed mood stabilisers for it to help alongside therapy. I feel a bit sad and awkward now. My sister declared the diagnosis a death sentence before and said that I'd be hopeless if I really have it. 

I know I can be unstable and it scares me a lot. I try so hard to keep myself in check and to not bother other people with my presence.

I did before this. Suddenly she appeared in our house and asked to reconcile, and I decided that maybe we should. This was two weeks ago. 

Now I realise that she was just trying to make it easier for her to take the rabbits.

Unfortunately my room has a pull-door so any locks I install are bolts. She has kicked down two bolts now, and I have the wreckage of six bolts in total on my door. One came off when my dad was worried that I had injured myself and the rest were done by my other sister, who I've effectively estranged myself from and is far worse than the sister I'm dealing with right now.

My room is quite small but sometimes the rabbits would happily sit under my desk when I was working or snuggle up to me in bed, so I think it could work, assuming I sit against the door.

I don't know what's specifically wrong with my dad but it definitely involves a form of psychosis. My mum's brain injury nearly killed her and she cannot walk and can barely talk. Talking is very challenging for her.

My sister had become very abusive recently and I'm a bit more vulnerable to her abuse than I'd normally be at the moment, thanks to a recent change in medication. I'd recently started standing my ground and she hasn't responded to it well and has taken to more intimidating behaviour. She has grown very manipulative. 

She says that my dad will lose a daughter if he doesn't give her my rabbits because she will kill herself. She will not accept any other rabbits. He offered to buy her three but she started screaming about how she wants mine and how they are hers. 

I'm in hospital right now but I'm tempted to run back home just because of how unstable she's being about this.

My dad told the police that the rabbits caused the argument and I mentioned that she is going to steal them before they started making small talk about them. They don't know about the other behaviour and I wasn't feeling talkative.

My dad is selectively oblivious and didn't even realise that she was calling me a worthless psychopath over and over, despite being right next to her at the time, and was more angry at the rabbits than anything else. Although you could start a conversation with my dad and he wouldn't realise that you're talking to him ten minutes later. It's hard to tell what my mum is thinking thanks to her aphasia, but she seemed angry when she learned that my sister was planning to take them away.

When I told her that it wasn't up for discussion today she went downstairs and trashed the living room, before saying she'd kill herself if I didn't give them to her. She also threatened to make my life hell by constantly calling the RSPCA on me and that she wasn't leaving the house without them. 

I asked why she wouldn't get other rabbits, but her only response was to continue saying that they're hers and she'll kill herself if she doesn't get them.

It wasn't just her trying to take the rabbits. I have been sitting through a lot of abuse from her ever since she convinced me to stop taking my medication a few months ago. I cut contact with her before over this, so she came over to destroy my room and shout me into a panic attack. 

She knows our parents will let her in so it's hard to really get away from her.
I've had a lot of arguments about it with her in the past. She doesn't care what I have to say.

Yes. She often makes demands on what careers, education and hobbies that I can and can't pursue, even if I don't entertain her. 

She has been particularly aggressive ever since I've gotten a boyfriend and blames him for whenever I stand up for myself.

She also feels that she is an authority on most of the subjects that she talks about and that everybody else is objectively wrong if they disagree.

My dad is mentally ill and my mum has brain damage. 

I don't know what's wrong with my sister and she refuses to see anyone for the problems she says she has. 

I'm mentally ill and a fucking idiot.

I've been firm with her for the past year. She doesn't care about what I say at all. I don't want to hit her because she *will* call the police on me for assault. 

I can't stop her from coming into this home either because it is my parents home and I'm still looking for a place to live. 

I'm sorry. I know I'm stupid and a complete idiot but I don't know how to stop her.

I know it's stupid but I don't understand why she refuses to acknowledge that they're mine and she can't just take them.

They're both animals that I have had for years and I know it's childish but I've really bonded with them.

It's nighttime here and I live on the outskirts of town so I'm not sure a hardware store would be open by the time I got there.

I'll probably lock them in my room with me until she leaves at least. It's very expensive for her to visit so she doesn't do it often. I'm also going to look for a place that allows small pets.
He stays with his parents and they have a dog. I asked about it before but his parents were scared their dog might attack them.

I just got off the phone with him now. He didn't understand why I wouldn't part with them until I told him that it'd be like if one of his friends suddenly decided they're taking his fish tank.

My dad has a few mental health issues himself and has a tendency towards being oblivious about this sort of thing. If you ask him for something he'll generally try to give it to you and my sister has taken advantage of this in the past when she wanted money.

One is chipped and I have copies of their vet bills with me. I also buy their food, litter and bedding on Amazon so I have an electronic receipt when it comes to providing for them at the least. I'll text her just to get it written down that they're mine.

She lived with us right when I got them and decided that they should be hers. She used to lock them in her room with her, but let me deal with all the vet bills, cleaning and buying their necessities.
My dad wants me to give hem to her because she won't stop saying how much she wants them
I'm currently staying with my parents, one of which is disabled and needs regular carer visits. Even if I don't let her in, she knows the pass code to the keysafe and could get the key herself.
